subject: Re: How to cache files/objects in map-reduce using rmr?

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: How to cache files/objects in map-reduce using rmr?
parts:
The information you provide is not very detailed, but my guess is that the way to do this in rmr is the same as in R without rmr, which is just put the top products in a variable and use it

products = read(...)

out = mapreduce(input = users, map = function(user, user-data) { expressions using user, user-data and products})

The job is loading the product information, but it's all happening behind the scenes.


Antonio

On Monday, July 9, 2012 6:40:18 AM UTC-7, rakeshrakshit wrote:
Hi all,

I have a use-case defined as follows. I have a list of popular products in a file and a file specifying users and products used by them.

Now using map-reduce for each user I want to sort out the popular products that the user is already using and recommend top 100 popular products for each user.

So my requirement needs the job to load the list of popular products in reduce phase of the map-reduce job.

Is there any way in rmr through which I can do so?

Thanks in advance.

Regards,
Rakesh Kumar Rakshit

Hi Antonio,

I have already tried the following code:

recommendProducts = function (input, output = "/tmp/recommendation1", pattern = " ") {
  return(mapreduce(input = input ,
            output = output,
            input.format = "text",
    output.format = "text",
            map = function(k,v) {
                              w<-strsplit(x = v,split = pattern)[[1]]
                keyval(w[1],w[2])
            },
        reduce = function(k,vv) {
            productsCount<-read.csv("products_popularity.txt",header=F,sep=" ",as.is=c(1,2))
            usedProducts <-unlist(vv)
            productsToRecommend<-character()
            for(product in productsCount[,1]){
                if(length(productsToRecommend)>500){
                    break           
                }
                if(!(product %in% usedProducts)){
                    productsToRecommend<-c(productsToRecommend,product)
                }
            }
                    keyval(k,productsToRecommend)}
                 
))}
